description: This file is a shell script used to test the update hook infrastructure of a Git repository. It sets up various hooks, performs git operations, verifies hook execution and inputs, and checks the behavior of hooks during push operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A testing helper function used to assert that a command or set of commands succeeds, and to document test steps.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a given file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of files or outputs for validation.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for testing purposes.

calls: test_expect_success 'pre-receive hook that forgets to read its input'
